matching.tolerance_rule: Invoice total may exceed the PO's remaining balance by the LOWER of 2% or INR 10,000. Anything over is a Hold.

duplicate_detection.normalise_invoice_number: Strip prefixes, separators and leading zeros before comparing (INV-0042 == 42)
duplicate_detection.rule: Same vendor + normalised invoice number match = duplicate. Same vendor + same PO + total within 0.5% = probable duplicate.

extraction.arithmetic_check: Sum of line items must equal subtotal, and subtotal + tax must equal total, within INR 1
extraction.non_invoice_handling: proforma, quotation, challan, statement, purchase_order -> NEEDS_REVIEW with reason 'not a tax invoice'. credit_note/debit_note -> NEEDS_REVIEW (not auto-paid)
extraction.inclusive_tax_handling: If tax.treatment == 'inclusive' and a rate is stated: taxable = total / (1 + rate/100); tax = total - taxable. Done in code, never by the model.

signals: total within tolerance of an open PO
po_inference.rule: If no PO reference is found, suggest the best-scoring open PO for that vendor but never auto-approve. Route to Needs Review with the score.

decisions.APPROVE: All checks pass. Ready for payment scheduling.
decisions.NEEDS_REVIEW: Process is uncertain (low confidence, inferred PO, small anomaly). A human confirms.
decisions.HOLD: A business rule failed but the invoice may be valid (over PO balance, PO closed). Needs action from requester or vendor.
decisions.REJECT: Must not be paid (duplicate, blocked or unknown vendor).

bank_account.compare: last 4 digits of extracted account vs vendors.bank_account_last4
bank_account.required_action: Call the vendor on the phone number in the vendor master (never the one on the invoice) and confirm the change before any payment

email_domain.compare: domain of extracted vendor email vs domain of vendors.contact_email
email_domain.on_mismatch: NEEDS_REVIEW alone; part of the HOLD narrative when the bank account also mismatches

gstin.compare: extracted vendor GSTIN vs vendors.gstin. Trust the GSTIN over the name.
gstin.on_mismatch: REJECT if the GSTIN matches no vendor; HOLD if it matches a different vendor than the name suggests

vendor_matching.note: Similarity is 0-1 on legal-suffix-stripped names and aliases. GSTIN is trusted over name.

line_matching.rule: Invoice lines are matched to PO lines by HSN/SAC (unique) or best description similarity. Cumulative billed quantity may not exceed the PO quantity. Unit price (ex-tax) must be within tolerance. Lines not on the PO are noted but do not decide alone.

compliance.tax_type_by_state: Vendor and buyer GSTIN state codes equal -> CGST+SGST; different -> IGST. Wrong type -> HOLD (buyer cannot claim input tax credit).

decision_levels.note: The decision is the most severe level raised by any check. 'warn' and 'info' notes never change the decision.
